aiStatement: PC Tax Amount: Identifies transaction tax amount in the Purchase Card Data Segment.

independentTestCandidate.title: PC Tax Amount is numeric, up to 7 digits with 2 assumed decimal places, when populated.

facts: Element 74 is numeric, variable length up to seven digits, with two assumed decimal places.
Its stated purpose is the transaction tax amount in Segment 104, the Purchase Card Data Segment.
The specification distinguishes Element 74 from Element 99 Tax Amount in Segment 100.
sourceConclusion.scopeNote: The source purpose statement is descriptive; the bounded AI cases provide no populated PC Tax Amount value from which to validate its semantics.

aiCaseReview.assessment: All three hash-verified candidate observations declare Element 74 omitted. The cases do not demonstrate a populated amount, character type, length boundary, or purpose relationship.

doesNotCover: semantic correctness of a transaction tax amount
